Each layout was sized many ways and run day-by-day over 2027. The code checked hard caps (flow rates, temperature drops, operating days) and grew any shortfall. It then compared the best three variants against the gas reference. The chosen design (1D-HP-EC@3000-N1-FC) was selected because it is the cheapest when CO₂ costs 137 €/t while meeting all demands and keeping N-1 reliability.
